macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible horn displays a lyrate spiral, sweeping posteriorly from the skull before curving vertically and slightly anteriorly toward the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tip constitutes approximately 8 percent of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white V-shaped chevron between the eyes and two vertically aligned white spots on the cheek region.
